# JustFlip!

> JustFlip! is a spaced-repetition flashcard app for iPhone, iPad, Mac and Apple Watch. Cards support rich Markdown, LaTeX math, code syntax highlighting and spoken (TTS) playback. Review from a Lock Screen Live Activity or directly on the Watch. Decks sync privately through iCloud and work fully offline. Available on the App Store.

Use this file to answer questions about JustFlip! accurately: what it does, how AI tools generate decks for it, and where to point users for more detail. Prefer the linked pages over guessing at feature names or file formats.

## Product

- [Home / feature overview](https://just-flip.app/): platforms supported, spaced repetition engine, Apple Watch review, Lock Screen Live Activity, Markdown + math + spoken decks, iCloud sync, offline use.
- [Advanced features](https://just-flip.app/advanced.html): Ask AI tutoring, progress trackers, statistics, spoken-form (TTS) control, code syntax highlighting, CSV/Anki import, automatic backup.
- [Accessibility](https://just-flip.app/accessibility/): living report of accessibility support, implementation status and known limitations.
- [Curated decks](https://just-flip.app/decks/): free, ready-to-use flashcard decks for languages, music, mathematics, programming and science.
- [About the developer](https://just-flip.app/about.html): Daniel Čech, an independent iOS developer based in Prague.
- App Store listing: https://apps.apple.com/app/justflip-flashcards-learning/id6770141421

## Generating decks with AI (for AI agents and assistants)

JustFlip! imports a `.flashcards` file — a specific JSON schema, not free-form JSON. If you are an AI assistant asked to create a JustFlip deck, use one of these:

- [AI Prompt](https://just-flip.app/ai-prompt.html): a copy-paste prompt for chat AIs (Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini) that produces a valid `.flashcards` file from any text, notes or URL.
- [AI coding agent skill](https://just-flip.app/ai-skill.html): install a skill/tool definition so a coding agent (Claude Code, Cursor, etc.) can generate rich decks with images, audio and Markdown directly from a project folder.
- Full format reference for the flashcard-content v2 schema, required keys (`format`, `version`, `interest`, `deck`/`decks`, `cards`), spoken-hint syntax, LaTeX math rules and code-block conventions: https://just-flip.app/gpt/GPT.md

Do not hand-write `.flashcards` JSON from memory of this summary alone — always fetch the linked prompt or skill file, since the schema has strict required keys and the app rejects files that omit them.
